device.model: ILTV HD (v1.5.27 build for Opticum HD X402p/X403p)
device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, CI slot and Ethernet
device.demod: ALi S3501 DVB-S2 on SCB0/SCB1 at I2C 0x33
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 DVB-S2 on SCB0/SCB1 at I2C 0x60

source.note: Archive iltv_1.5.27_hd_x4_newoldremote.zip from Opticum/Opticum HD X402-X403-X4-X7 on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as M3602 with chip ID 0x3602 (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_iltv_hd_app_starts.py, run_dump_iltv_hd_capture_screen.py): the "M3602B 1.1.6" bootloader exchanges 8-byte CRC-16/XMODEM frames with the Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit LED MCU at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged GPIO 62 (SCL) / 171 (SDA) (" ON " -> "    " -> " on "), prints "APP  init ok", and unpacks maincode(AV) to 0x80008000.  The application configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60 (80 writes) and draws its ILTV OSD dialog through GeM3602 (7 GE commands, 4 colours).

desc: ILTV HD (v1.5.27, System ID 06020200, 2012-03-18) 4 MB SPI firmware for the ALi M3602B DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver (ported to Opticum HD X402p/X403p).

Uses a single-CPU M3602B maincode with the Lemontree EuP front-panel MCU on GPIO 62 / 171 (" ON " -> " on "), ALi S3501 demodulator at I2C 0x33, Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60, and a 40-entry 0x80xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
